title: Liquid Driver (LQDR) — Fantom + BSC zombie custody deep dive
closed_reasons: MasterChef (Sushi MCV1): withdraw/emergencyWithdraw are self-only; all admin fns Ownable (owner = Gnosis Safe 3-of-4); lqdrPerBlock=0; no rescue/mint path
MiniChef (TransparentUpgradeableProxy -> MiniChefV2 logic, verified on BSC Etherscan): user accounting; foreign withdraw reverts in all 48 pools; initialize done; set/upgrade gated
37 Pickle-style LqdrStrategy contracts: withdraw/withdrawAll revert '!depositor' (depositor = MiniChef); harvest gated by harvester whitelist
34 shadow farms (proxies): every entry point (withdraw/withdrawAll/deposit/harvest/emergencyWithdraw) reverts from a fresh EOA; owner/admin gated
xLQDR veLQDR: lockless withdraw() is a zero-value no-op; only lockers can withdraw after expiry; admin has no fund-moving function
BSC MiniChef: 6 pools, all empty; admin/upgrade gated
Burner 0x05b7109b: 391-byte contract with only name(); 92,048.19 LQDR permanently stuck (S)

xLQDR 0x3ae658656d1c526144db371faef2fff7170654ee (veLQDR): supply 3,925,045.57 LQDR locked (nominal $176,902 at $0.04507); voting power 708,093.68; admin/controller 0x383ea123...

Rewarder 0x211413ebd4e439535df54a63d10bf844a85e981a (for MiniChef pids 1 and 10) holds 9,746.68 WFTM (~$526) as pending secondary rewards; harvest/withdraw/emergencyWithdraw revert from a fresh EOA (userInfo=0)

Exit-liquidity ceiling: deepest LQDR/FTM pair 0x506ddcc751c7d500f983ffda6ddefbe458ba2c33 holds 18,669.5 WFTM + 22,005.3 LQDR; constant-product dump of all 3.925M locked LQDR yields only 18,565 WFTM (~$1.0k)
Burner 0x05b7109b2dae299d882c410c1a281fc194658e89: holds 92,048.19 LQDR; bytecode has only name() - unrecoverable

Dangerous-call simulations from a fresh EOA: MC mint/add/set/updateEmissionRate/transferOwnership -> revert; MiniChef initialize -> 'already initialized', setFeeAddress/setTreasuryAddress -> FORBIDDEN, upgradeTo -> revert; strategy withdraw -> '!depositor'; shadow farm withdraw/deposit/harvest -> revert; xLQDR lockless withdraw -> no-op (delta 0)
Fantom bridged assets are heavily de-pegged (LINK $0.17 vs $12 mainnet; miMATIC $0.055; FRAX $0.88), so nominal LP values overstate realizable value by ~3.6x on the strategy LP alone
caveats: H-O figure is nominal on-chain custody attributable to users at 2026-10-15 DefiLlama prices; realizable value is far lower (thin/broken Fantom exit liquidity; DEX-implied strategy LP ~$50k; xLQDR dump ceiling ~$0.2-1.0k)

Privileged upgrade paths exist (proxy admins owned by EOA 0x383ea123... and 0x91e458fc...; Safe 3-of-4 for MasterChef) - key compromise would allow upgrade-to-malicious, but this is not an unprivileged path
FTM MiniChef implementation 0x4b7e4f46... is unverified (selector set matches MiniChefV2 + lqdrPerBlock; all probed behaviours match the verified BSC implementation)
qLQDR/mxLQDR/liHND vaults marketed by the project could not be located from public sources and are not covered
Per-user pending LQDR not enumerated; surplus LQDR in MasterChef beyond pending rewards is unrescuable (no rescue function)
CI fingerprint `from`-address simulations returned provider errors; superseded by Foundry fork tests (authoritative)
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0.00 live from Liquid Driver: every withdrawal path is depositor-gated (MasterChef/MiniChef/strategies/shadow farms verified by fork PoC), admin paths need a 3-of-4 Safe or team EOAs, and xLQDR lockers can only withdraw their own locks; ~$373k of nominal user custody remains but is user-recoverable only, with a tiny realizable fraction.
